directive.name: tsdoc
directive.description: Validate that all public APIs have proper TSDoc documentation

context.principle: All exported symbols must have TSDoc documentation
TSDoc must use multi-line format, not single-line
@param tags must use hyphen separator: @param name - description

process.rule: Add TSDoc to all exported functions, classes, interfaces, and types

check.reason: Single-line TSDoc on exports - use multi-line format
Banner/divider comments are noise, not documentation
@param missing hyphen separator - use @param name - description

check.item: No file-level TSDoc at line 1 (document exports, not files)

example.explanation: Single-line format is not proper TSDoc

example.code: // WRONG: No hyphen * @param timeout The timeout value
example.explanation: Missing hyphen separator after parameter name

example.code: // CORRECT: With hyphen * @param timeout - The timeout value in milliseconds.
example.explanation: Hyphen separator required between name and description
